name: Mastra
description: Mastra is an open-source TypeScript framework for building AI agents and workflows, from the team behind Gatsby. YC W25 cohort with $13M seed (October 2025); Mastra 1.0 launched January 2026. Provides primitives for tools, workflows, memory, RAG, and evaluation.
pricingDetails: Framework: open source (Apache 2.0). Mastra Cloud: paid hosting tiers (pricing not consistently published).
